news.title: White House counsel says Supreme Court delivered ‘generational win’ on presidential firing power
news.summary: White House counsel Will Scharf praised the Supreme Court’s June decision strengthening presidential firing power as a “generational win,” saying Thursday it righted what he viewed as a “historic constitutional wrong.” “A president who can’t control who’s exercising the executive power that is vested in him, that’s a cabined presidency,” Scharf said during the Federalist…
